feedback.msgMuscle4: Each muscle group will be trained twice per week — the research-backed minimum for maximizing hypertrophy.
feedback.msgMuscle3: Good starting point. Full body sessions will hit each muscle 3 times per week. Slightly less volume per muscle than optimal but effective.
feedback.msgMuscle2: 2 days is below the research minimum for optimal muscle growth. Results will come but significantly slower. Consider adding a third day if possible.
feedback.msgEndurance: For endurance goals, higher rep ranges and shorter rest periods will be prioritized. Consistency matters more than frequency.
feedback.msgFat: For fat loss, resistance training preserves muscle while in a caloric deficit. Higher density training keeps heart rate elevated.
feedback.msgDefault: Your schedule will be optimized for your selected goals.

profile.healthDesc:
Helix reads your sleep duration, HRV, and resting heart rate to show a daily recovery status. No data is written or shared.

Your smartwatch syncs to {{provider}} through its own companion app{{companion}} — Helix reads from there, not from the watch directly.
profile.noHealthToday: No health data found for today. Make sure your watch has synced.
profile.sourceSleepDesc: Last 18 hours of sleep stages from your watch
profile.sourceHrvDescIos: Heart rate variability (SDNN) from Apple Health
profile.sourceHrvDescAndroid: Heart rate variability (RMSSD) from Health Connect

alerts.connectedNoDataIos: Helix connected to Apple Health but found no data. If you declined access, enable it in Health → Sharing → Apps → Helix. Otherwise make sure your watch syncs sleep, HRV and heart rate to the Health app.
alerts.connectedNoDataAndroid: Helix connected to Health Connect but found no data. Open your watch's companion app (Samsung Health, Fitbit, Garmin Connect…) and enable syncing to Health Connect — Helix will then pick it up automatically.
alerts.hcRequiredMsg: Helix reads watch data through Google Health Connect, which is not installed on this phone.
alerts.updateHcMsg: Your Health Connect app needs an update before Helix can read data from it.
alerts.permissionNeededIos: Helix needs access in the Health app. Open Health → Sharing → Apps → Helix and allow sleep, heart rate and steps.
alerts.permissionNeededAndroid: Helix needs health permissions. Try again, or grant access directly in Health Connect settings — the prompt may stop appearing after a few declines.

bodyComp.title: Body composition
bodyComp.empty: Log your weight daily for trend analysis. After 7 days you will see your moving average, rate of change, and projection to your target.
bodyComp.projection: At your current pace you will reach {{target}} kg in approximately {{weeks}} weeks ({{date}}).
bodyComp.projectionDisclaimer: Rate of change varies week to week — this is a direction, not a guarantee.

alerts.waterBody: Your weight has risen quickly in the last 2 days. Research shows menstrual cycle water retention averages ~0.5kg and peaks on day 1 of flow (Kanellakis et al. 2023). This is not fat gain.
alerts.muscleLossBody: Losing more than 1kg/week consistently. Research shows 20–40% of total weight lost at this rate comes from muscle. Slow the deficit or increase protein above 1.6g/kg bodyweight.
alerts.gainFastBody: At your training level, gaining faster than ~0.12kg/week primarily adds fat, not muscle. Consider reducing your surplus.
alerts.stalledBody: Weight hasn't moved meaningfully in 2+ weeks despite your goal. See the plateau section for evidence-based next steps.

block.newSub: Your exercises have rotated to keep your body adapting. Same movements, fresh stimulus.

readiness.adviceModerate: HRV below your baseline. Consider reducing compound weights by 10% today.
readiness.adviceLow: HRV significantly below baseline. Reduce load, skip the last isolation exercise, or take a rest day.

rest.title: Rest day
rest.sub: Recovery is when your muscles actually grow. Prioritize sleep and protein today.

compact.subOn: Same exercises, fewer sets. Keep the weight and push the last set of each.
